1	"""
2	training/trainer.py
3	====================
4	RLTrainer — wires SB3 PPO + custom CompressorPolicy + CompressionEnv.
5	
6	Responsibilities
7	----------------
8	1. Build ``CompressionEnv`` (vectorised via ``make_vec_env``).
9	2. Instantiate SB3 ``PPO`` with ``CompressorPolicy`` as the policy class.
10	3. Attach TensorBoard + custom callbacks for episode logging and checkpointing.
11	4. Expose ``train()``, ``save_checkpoint()``, ``load_checkpoint()``.
12	
13	Why a thin wrapper instead of calling SB3 directly?
14	----------------------------------------------------
15	- Encapsulates the tedious ``policy_kwargs`` plumbing (passing the compressor
16	  and value_hidden_dim into CompressorPolicy.__init__).
17	- Provides a single place for project-specific callbacks (episode-level reward
18	  logging, compressed-state quality metrics).
19	- Makes checkpoint/resume logic reusable from ``scripts/run_training.py``.
20	
21	SB3 version note
22	----------------
23	This code targets ``stable-baselines3 >= 2.3``. The ``PPO`` constructor
24	accepts ``policy_kwargs`` which are forwarded to the policy ``__init__``.
25	Custom policies must be passed as a class (not an instance).
26	"""

72	class EpisodeLogCallback(BaseCallback):
73	    """
74	    SB3 callback that extracts per-episode reward components from the ``info``
75	    dict returned by ``CompressionEnv.step()`` and writes them to TensorBoard
76	    and (optionally) to the ``RLRunLogger`` JSONL store.
77	
78	    Enhanced over the original to also log:
79	    - ``episode/total_steps`` — episode length (diagnoses over/under-planning)
80	    - ``episode/tool_calls_total`` — total tool invocations
81	    - ``episode/tool_success_rate`` — fraction of successful tool calls
82	    - ``episode/reward_mean_20`` — rolling mean of total reward (last 20 episodes)
83	    - ``episode/num_compressions`` — number of compression events in the episode
84	
85	    Parameters
86	    ----------
87	    run_logger        : Optional ``RLRunLogger``.  When provided, each completed
88	                        episode is also written to ``episode_metrics.jsonl``.
89	    tb_log_prefix     : TensorBoard tag prefix.  Defaults to ``"episode"``.
90	    rolling_window    : Window size for the rolling reward mean.
91	    episode_save_freq : Save a full EpisodeLog JSON every N episodes.
92	                        0 = never (recommended for Colab to conserve storage).
93	    episodes_dir      : Directory for full EpisodeLog JSON files.
94	    verbose           : SB3 verbosity level.
95	    """
96	
97	    def __init__(
98	        self,
99	        run_logger: "RLRunLogger | None" = None,
100	        tb_log_prefix: str = "episode",
101	        rolling_window: int = 20,
102	        episode_save_freq: int = 0,
103	        episodes_dir: str | Path = "outputs/episodes",
104	        verbose: int = 0,
105	    ) -> None:
106	        super().__init__(verbose=verbose)
107	        self._prefix = tb_log_prefix
108	        self._episode_count = 0
109	        self._run_logger = run_logger
110	        self._reward_window: deque[float] = deque(maxlen=rolling_window)
111	        self._episode_save_freq = episode_save_freq
112	        self._episodes_dir = Path(episodes_dir)
113	
114	    def _on_step(self) -> bool:
115	        """Called after each env step. Returns True to continue training."""
116	        infos = self.locals.get("infos", [])
117	        for info in infos:
118	            if "reward_components" not in info:
119	                continue
120	            rc = info["reward_components"]
121	            episode_log = info.get("episode_log")
122	
123	            # ── Reward components ──────────────────────────────────────────────
124	            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/hard_constraint_score", rc.hard_constraint_score)
125	            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/soft_constraint_score", rc.soft_constraint_score)
126	            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/tool_efficiency_score", rc.tool_efficiency_score)
127	            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/tool_failure_penalty", rc.tool_failure_penalty)
128	            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/logical_consistency_score", rc.logical_consistency_score)
129	            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/total_reward", rc.total_reward)
130	            if rc.terminal_itinerary_score is not None:
131	                self.logger.record(
132	                    f"{self._prefix}/terminal_itinerary_score",
133	                    rc.terminal_itinerary_score,
134	                )
135	
136	            # ── Rolling reward mean ────────────────────────────────────────────
137	            self._reward_window.append(rc.total_reward)
138	            reward_mean = sum(self._reward_window) / len(self._reward_window)
139	            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/reward_mean_20", reward_mean)
140	
141	            # ── Episode-level metrics from EpisodeLog ─────────────────────────
142	            total_steps = 0
143	            tool_calls_total = 0
144	            tool_success_rate = 0.0
145	            num_compressions = 0
146	            request_id = info.get("request_id", "")
147	            agent_mode = ""
148	
149	            if episode_log is not None:
150	                total_steps = getattr(episode_log, "total_steps", 0)
151	                num_compressions = len(getattr(episode_log, "compressed_states", ()))
152	                agent_mode = getattr(episode_log, "agent_mode", "")
153	
154	                tool_stats = getattr(episode_log, "tool_stats", ())
155	                if tool_stats:
156	                    total_calls = sum(getattr(ts, "call_count", 0) for ts in tool_stats)
157	                    total_success = sum(getattr(ts, "success_count", 0) for ts in tool_stats)
158	                    tool_calls_total = total_calls
159	                    tool_success_rate = total_success / total_calls if total_calls > 0 else 0.0
160	
161	                request_id = getattr(episode_log, "request_id", request_id)
162	
163	            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/total_steps", total_steps)
164	            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/tool_calls_total", tool_calls_total)
165	            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/tool_success_rate", tool_success_rate)
166	            self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/num_compressions", num_compressions)
167	
168	            # ── System performance metrics (observational, no reward impact) ────
169	            _pm = getattr(episode_log, "performance_metrics", None) if episode_log else None
170	            if _pm is not None:
171	                if _pm.episode_wall_time_ms is not None:
172	                    self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/perf_wall_time_ms", _pm.episode_wall_time_ms)
173	                if _pm.total_llm_latency_ms is not None:
174	                    self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/perf_total_llm_latency_ms", _pm.total_llm_latency_ms)
175	                if _pm.llm_latency_fraction is not None:
176	                    self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/perf_llm_latency_fraction", _pm.llm_latency_fraction)
177	                if _pm.total_tokens is not None:
178	                    self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/perf_total_tokens", float(_pm.total_tokens))
179	                if _pm.estimated_cost_usd is not None:
180	                    self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/perf_estimated_cost_usd", _pm.estimated_cost_usd)
181	                if _pm.total_parse_retries is not None:
182	                    self.logger.record(f"{self._prefix}/perf_total_parse_retries", float(_pm.total_parse_retries))
183	
184	            # Flush episode metrics to TensorBoard immediately rather than waiting
185	            # for the rollout boundary (n_steps × n_envs steps away).
186	            self.logger.dump(self.num_timesteps)
187	
188	            # ── Persist to JSONL ───────────────────────────────────────────────
189	            if self._run_logger is not None:
190	                summary = EpisodeMetricsSummary(
191	                    episode_id=getattr(episode_log, "episode_id", "") if episode_log else "",
192	                    request_id=request_id,
193	                    agent_mode=agent_mode,
194	                    total_steps=total_steps,
195	                    success=getattr(episode_log, "success", False) if episode_log else False,
196	                    total_reward=rc.total_reward,
197	                    hard_constraint_score=rc.hard_constraint_score,
198	                    soft_constraint_score=rc.soft_constraint_score,
199	                    tool_efficiency_score=rc.tool_efficiency_score,
200	                    tool_failure_penalty=rc.tool_failure_penalty,
201	                    logical_consistency_score=rc.logical_consistency_score,
202	                    terminal_itinerary_score=rc.terminal_itinerary_score,
203	                    tool_calls_total=tool_calls_total,
204	                    tool_success_rate=tool_success_rate,
205	                    num_compressions=num_compressions,
206	                    reward_mean_20=reward_mean,
207	                    perf_episode_wall_time_ms=getattr(_pm, "episode_wall_time_ms", None) if _pm else None,
208	                    perf_total_llm_latency_ms=getattr(_pm, "total_llm_latency_ms", None) if _pm else None,
209	                    perf_llm_latency_fraction=getattr(_pm, "llm_latency_fraction", None) if _pm else None,
210	                    perf_total_tokens=getattr(_pm, "total_tokens", None) if _pm else None,
211	                    perf_estimated_cost_usd=getattr(_pm, "estimated_cost_usd", None) if _pm else None,
212	                    perf_total_parse_retries=getattr(_pm, "total_parse_retries", None) if _pm else None,
213	                )
214	                self._run_logger.log_episode_summary(summary)
215	
216	            # ── Optionally persist full EpisodeLog (storage-intensive) ─────────
217	            if (
218	                self._episode_save_freq > 0
219	                and episode_log is not None
220	                and self._episode_count % self._episode_save_freq == 0
221	            ):
222	                try:
223	                    from optimized_llm_planning_memory.utils.episode_io import save_episode
224	                    self._episodes_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
225	                    save_episode(episode_log, self._episodes_dir)
226	                except Exception:
227	                    pass  # never crash training over a logging failure
228	
229	            self._episode_count += 1
230	        return True
231

233	class CompressorCheckpointCallback(BaseCallback):
234	    """
235	    Checkpoints the compressor model (HF save_pretrained format) alongside
236	    the SB3 PPO zip checkpoint.
237	
238	    SB3's built-in ``CheckpointCallback`` saves the full policy; this callback
239	    additionally saves just the compressor weights via
240	    ``TrainableCompressorBase.save_checkpoint()``, which is lighter-weight
241	    and loadable without SB3.
242	    """
243	
244	    def __init__(
245	        self,
246	        compressor: TrainableCompressorBase,
247	        save_dir: str | Path,
248	        save_every_n_steps: int = 10_000,
249	        verbose: int = 0,
250	    ) -> None:
251	        super().__init__(verbose=verbose)
252	        self._compressor = compressor
253	        self._save_dir = Path(save_dir)
254	        self._save_every = save_every_n_steps
255	        self._last_saved = 0
256	
257	    def _on_step(self) -> bool:
258	        step = self.num_timesteps
259	        if step - self._last_saved >= self._save_every:
260	            ckpt_path = self._save_dir / f"compressor_step_{step}"
261	            ckpt_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
262	            self._compressor.save_checkpoint(str(ckpt_path))
263	            if self.verbose >= 1:
264	                print(f"[CompressorCheckpointCallback] Saved compressor to {ckpt_path}")
265	            self._last_saved = step
266	        return True
267	
268	
269	class LoggerCapturePatch(BaseCallback):
270	    """
271	    Patches the SB3 logger's dump() at training start to snapshot name_to_value
272	    before SB3 clears it.
273	
274	    Root cause: PPOUpdateMetricsCallback._on_rollout_end() fires BEFORE train(),
275	    so by the time the rollout ends, the previous train() has already called
276	    logger.dump() which wipes all train/* keys. This callback intercepts dump()
277	    once the logger exists (after _setup_learn) and stores a snapshot that
278	    PPOUpdateMetricsCallback can read instead.
279	    """
280	
281	    def _on_training_start(self) -> None:
282	        _captured: dict = {}
283	        _orig_dump = self.model.logger.dump
284	
285	        def _capturing_dump(step: int = 0) -> None:
286	            _captured.clear()
287	            _captured.update(self.model.logger.name_to_value)
288	            _orig_dump(step)
289	
290	        self.model.logger.dump = _capturing_dump  # type: ignore[method-assign]
291	        self.model._captured_log_values = _captured  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
292	
293	    def _on_step(self) -> bool:
294	        return True
295	
296

300	class RewardPredictorCallback(BaseCallback):
301	    """
302	    SB3 callback that feeds completed-episode data into a RewardPredictorComponent.
303	
304	    After each step, it scans the ``infos`` list for terminated episodes.
305	    For each terminated episode, it extracts five scalar features from the
306	    ``reward_components`` dict and calls ``reward_predictor.add_episode()``.
307	    Every ``fit_every_n_episodes`` episodes it triggers ``reward_predictor.fit()``.
308	
309	    Parameters
310	    ----------
311	    reward_predictor     : RewardPredictorComponent to update.
312	    fit_every_n_episodes : How often (in completed episodes) to call fit().
313	    verbose              : SB3 verbosity level.
314	    """
315	
316	    def __init__(
317	        self,
318	        reward_predictor: Any,
319	        fit_every_n_episodes: int = 50,
320	        verbose: int = 0,
321	    ) -> None:
322	        super().__init__(verbose=verbose)
323	        self._reward_predictor = reward_predictor
324	        self._fit_every = fit_every_n_episodes
325	        self._episode_count = 0
326	
327	    def _on_step(self) -> bool:
328	        infos = self.locals.get("infos", [])
329	        dones = self.locals.get("dones", [])
330	
331	        for info, done in zip(infos, dones):
332	            if not done:
333	                continue
334	            rc = info.get("reward_components")
335	            if rc is None:
336	                continue
337	
338	            # Build feature dict from RewardComponents fields
339	            features = {
340	                "hard_constraint_score": float(getattr(rc, "hard_constraint_score", 0.0)),
341	                "soft_constraint_score": float(getattr(rc, "soft_constraint_score", 0.0)),
342	                "tool_efficiency_score": float(getattr(rc, "tool_efficiency_score", 0.0)),
343	                "steps_per_episode": float(info.get("steps_per_episode_normalized", 0.0)),
344	                "budget_adherence": float(info.get("budget_adherence", 0.0)),
345	            }
346	            reward = float(getattr(rc, "total_reward", 0.0))
347	            self._reward_predictor.add_episode(features=features, reward=reward)
348	            self._episode_count += 1
349	
350	            if self._episode_count % self._fit_every == 0:
351	                fitted = self._reward_predictor.fit()
352	                if self.verbose >= 1:
353	                    status = "OK" if fitted else "skipped (insufficient data)"
354	                    print(
355	                        f"[RewardPredictorCallback] fit() at episode "
356	                        f"{self._episode_count}: {status}"
357	                    )
358	
359	        return True

400	class ValEvalCallback(BaseCallback):
401	    """
402	    SB3 callback that periodically evaluates the current policy on a held-out
403	    validation set and logs the results to TensorBoard.
404	
405	    Fires every ``eval_freq`` timesteps. Runs ``n_val_episodes`` complete
406	    episodes sequentially (DummyVecEnv, 1 env) using the val split of user
407	    requests — separate from the training pool — to give an unbiased reward
408	    estimate. Metrics appear under the ``val/`` TensorBoard prefix and can be
409	    used to detect overfitting or guide early stopping.
410	
411	    Why DummyVecEnv (not SubprocVecEnv)?
412	    -------------------------------------
413	    Val eval runs synchronously in the main process so it can query
414	    ``self.model.predict()`` with the live policy weights. SubprocVecEnv
415	    would fork worker processes that carry stale weights, producing incorrect
416	    evaluation results.
417	
418	    Parameters
419	    ----------
420	    val_env_factory : Callable that returns a fresh CompressionEnv built from
421	                      the val user requests pool.
422	    n_val_episodes  : Number of complete episodes to run per evaluation event.
423	    eval_freq       : Evaluate every this many timesteps. 0 = disabled.
424	    verbose         : SB3 verbosity level.
425	    """
426	
427	    def __init__(
428	        self,
429	        val_env_factory: Callable[[], "CompressionEnv"],
430	        n_val_episodes: int = 4,
431	        eval_freq: int = 100,
432	        verbose: int = 0,
433	    ) -> None:
434	        super().__init__(verbose=verbose)
435	        self._factory = val_env_factory
436	        self._n_val_episodes = n_val_episodes
437	        self._eval_freq = eval_freq
438	        self._last_eval = 0
439	
440	    def _on_step(self) -> bool:
441	        if self._eval_freq == 0 or self.num_timesteps - self._last_eval < self._eval_freq:
442	            return True
443	        self._last_eval = self.num_timesteps
444	        self._run_eval()
445	        return True
446	
447	    def _run_eval(self) -> None:
448	        env = DummyVecEnv([self._factory])
449	        obs = env.reset()
450	        rewards: list[float] = []
451	        hard_scores: list[float] = []
452	        soft_scores: list[float] = []
453	        episodes_done = 0
454	
455	        while episodes_done < self._n_val_episodes:
456	            action, _ = self.model.predict(obs, deterministic=True)
457	            obs, _reward, dones, infos = env.step(action)
458	            for done, info in zip(dones, infos):
459	                if done:
460	                    rc = info.get("reward_components")
461	                    if rc is not None:
462	                        rewards.append(float(getattr(rc, "total_reward", 0.0)))
463	                        hard_scores.append(float(getattr(rc, "hard_constraint_score", 0.0)))
464	                        soft_scores.append(float(getattr(rc, "soft_constraint_score", 0.0)))
465	                    episodes_done += 1
466	
467	        env.close()
468	
469	        if rewards:
470	            self.logger.record("val/mean_reward", float(np.mean(rewards)))
471	            self.logger.record("val/hard_constraint_score", float(np.mean(hard_scores)))
472	            self.logger.record("val/soft_constraint_score", float(np.mean(soft_scores)))
473	            self.logger.dump(self.num_timesteps)
474	            log.info(
475	                "val_eval.done",
476	                timestep=self.num_timesteps,
477	                n_episodes=len(rewards),
478	                mean_reward=round(float(np.mean(rewards)), 4),
479	                hard_score=round(float(np.mean(hard_scores)), 4),
480	            )

483	class PPOUpdateMetricsCallback(BaseCallback):
484	    """
485	    Captures per-PPO-update diagnostics from SB3's internal logger and writes
486	    them to both TensorBoard and the ``RLRunLogger`` JSONL store.
487	
488	    Fires on ``_on_rollout_end()``, which SB3 calls after each complete
489	    PPO update cycle (after the n_steps rollout has been collected and all
490	    n_epochs gradient steps have run).
491	
492	    Why capture here instead of relying on SB3's default TensorBoard output?
493	    -------------------------------------------------------------------------
494	    SB3 computes ``approx_kl``, ``clip_fraction``, and ``explained_variance``
495	    internally but does not always expose them as standalone TensorBoard
496	    scalars in all versions.  This callback explicitly re-records them so they
497	    are always visible, and also writes them to JSONL for offline analysis
498	    without a running TensorBoard server.
499	
500	    Parameters
501	    ----------
502	    run_logger : ``RLRunLogger`` instance for JSONL persistence.
503	    verbose    : SB3 verbosity level.
504	    """
505	
506	    def __init__(self, run_logger: "RLRunLogger", verbose: int = 0) -> None:
507	        super().__init__(verbose=verbose)
508	        self._run_logger = run_logger
509	        self._update_count = 0
510	
511	    def _on_rollout_end(self) -> None:
512	        """Called after each complete PPO update cycle."""
513	        # Prefer captured values (snapshot taken just before dump() clears the logger).
514	        # Falls back to name_to_value for the very first rollout before any train() runs.
515	        captured = getattr(self.model, "_captured_log_values", None)
516	        log_values = captured if captured else self.model.logger.name_to_value  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
517	
518	        def _get(key: str, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
519	            val = log_values.get(key, default)
520	            return float(val) if val is not None else default
521	
522	        def _get_opt(key: str) -> float | None:
523	            val = log_values.get(key)
524	            return float(val) if val is not None else None
525	
526	        # Advantages mean/std from SB3's rollout buffer (available after collect_rollouts)
527	        adv_mean: float | None = None
528	        adv_std: float | None = None
529	        try:
530	            rollout_buf = self.model.rollout_buffer  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
531	            advs = rollout_buf.advantages.flatten()
532	            if len(advs) > 0:
533	                adv_mean = float(advs.mean())
534	                adv_std = float(advs.std())
535	        except Exception:
536	            pass
537	
538	        # Read LR directly from optimizer as ground truth (logger value may be stale).
539	        opt_lr: float = 0.0
540	        try:
541	            opt_lr = float(self.model.policy.optimizer.param_groups[0]["lr"])  # type: ignore
542	        except Exception:
543	            opt_lr = _get("train/learning_rate")
544	
545	        metrics = PPOUpdateMetrics(
546	            update_step=self._update_count,
547	            policy_loss=_get("train/policy_gradient_loss"),
548	            value_loss=_get("train/value_loss"),
549	            entropy_loss=_get("train/entropy_loss"),
550	            total_loss=_get("train/loss"),
551	            clip_fraction=_get("train/clip_fraction"),
552	            approx_kl=_get("train/approx_kl"),
553	            explained_variance=_get("train/explained_variance"),
554	            learning_rate=opt_lr,
555	            # grad_norm: SB3 logs this when max_grad_norm > 0
556	            grad_norm=_get_opt("train/grad_norm"),
557	            advantages_mean=adv_mean,
558	            advantages_std=adv_std,
559	            num_timesteps=self.num_timesteps,
560	        )
561	
562	        # Ensure these appear in TensorBoard even if SB3 doesn't record them by default
563	        self.logger.record("train/approx_kl", metrics.approx_kl)
564	        self.logger.record("train/clip_fraction", metrics.clip_fraction)
565	        self.logger.record("train/explained_variance", metrics.explained_variance)
566	        if metrics.grad_norm is not None:
567	            self.logger.record("train/grad_norm", metrics.grad_norm)
568	        if adv_mean is not None:
569	            self.logger.record("train/advantages_mean", adv_mean)
570	            self.logger.record("train/advantages_std", adv_std or 0.0)
571	
572	        self._run_logger.log_ppo_update(metrics)
573	        self._update_count += 1
574	
575	    def _on_step(self) -> bool:
576	        return True

580	    """
581	    Wires SB3 PPO with the custom ``CompressorPolicy`` and ``CompressionEnv``.
582	
583	    Parameters
584	    ----------
585	    compressor        : Trainable compressor model (HF or custom).
586	    agent_factory     : Callable[[], ReActAgent] — creates a fresh agent per episode.
587	    simulator_factory : Callable[[int], SimulatorProtocol] — creates a fresh sim per episode.
588	    user_requests     : Training set of UserRequest objects.
589	    val_requests      : Optional validation set. When non-empty, a ValEvalCallback is added
590	                        that logs val/mean_reward to TensorBoard every val_eval_freq timesteps.
591	    config            : Full training configuration (n_envs, PPO hyperparams, paths).
592	    env_config        : Environment configuration (max token dims).
593	    reward_config     : Reward component weights.
594	    tokenizer         : HF tokenizer (or None to use char-level fallback in CompressionEnv).
595	    tensorboard_log   : Directory for TensorBoard logs. Defaults to ``outputs/logs``.
596	    checkpoint_dir    : Directory for SB3 + compressor checkpoints. Defaults to ``outputs/checkpoints``.
597	    training_log_dir  : Root directory for training-only JSONL artifacts (PPO update metrics,

599	                        subdirectory under this path. Defaults to ``outputs/training``.
600	    reward_predictor  : Optional RewardPredictorComponent. When provided, a
601	                        RewardPredictorCallback is added to the callback list so
602	                        that a PyTorch linear model trains on episode rewards.
603	    reward_predictor_fit_every : How often (in episodes) the callback triggers fit().
604	    """
605	
606	    def __init__(
607	        self,
608	        compressor: TrainableCompressorBase,
609	        agent_factory: Callable,
610	        simulator_factory: Callable[[int], SimulatorProtocol],
611	        user_requests: list[UserRequest],
612	        val_requests: list[UserRequest] | None = None,
613	        config: TrainingConfig | None = None,
614	        env_config: EnvConfig | None = None,
615	        reward_config: RewardConfig | None = None,
616	        simulator_config: SimulatorConfig | None = None,
617	        tokenizer: Any = None,
618	        tensorboard_log: str | Path = "outputs/logs",
619	        checkpoint_dir: str | Path = "outputs/checkpoints",
620	        training_log_dir: str | Path = "outputs/training",
621	        reward_predictor: Any = None,
622	        reward_predictor_fit_every: int = 50,
623	    ) -> None:
624	        self._compressor = compressor
625	        self._agent_factory = agent_factory
626	        self._simulator_factory = simulator_factory
627	        self._user_requests = user_requests
628	        self._val_requests: list[UserRequest] = val_requests or []
629	        self._config = config or TrainingConfig()
630	        self._env_config = env_config or EnvConfig()
631	        self._reward_config = reward_config or RewardConfig()
632	        self._simulator_config = simulator_config or SimulatorConfig()
633	        self._tokenizer = tokenizer
634	        self._tensorboard_log = Path(tensorboard_log)
635	        self._checkpoint_dir = Path(checkpoint_dir)
636	        self._training_log_dir = Path(training_log_dir)
637	        self._reward_predictor = reward_predictor
638	        self._reward_predictor_fit_every = reward_predictor_fit_every
639	
640	        self._ppo: PPO | None = None
641	        self._device = self._resolve_device(self._config.device)
642	        log.info("trainer.device", device=self._device)
643	
644	    @staticmethod
645	    def _resolve_device(device_cfg: str) -> str:
646	        """Resolve 'auto' to 'cuda' or 'cpu' based on availability."""
647	        if device_cfg == "auto":
648	            return "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
649	        return device_cfg
650	
651	    # ── Public interface ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
652	
653	    def train(self, num_timesteps: int | None = None) -> None:
654	        """
655	        Run PPO training for ``num_timesteps`` environment steps.
656	
657	        If ``config.resume_from`` is set, the SB3 model is loaded from that
658	        checkpoint before continuing. Compressor weights are loaded separately
659	        via ``load_checkpoint()``.
660	
661	        Parameters
662	        ----------
663	        num_timesteps : Override for the number of training steps.
664	                        Defaults to ``config.num_timesteps``.
665	        """
666	        n_steps = num_timesteps or self._config.num_timesteps
667	
668	        # Create a timestamped run directory for training-only JSONL artifacts.
669	        # Each train() call gets its own directory so runs don't overwrite each other.
670	        run_id = datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
671	        run_logger = RLRunLogger(run_id=run_id, training_dir=self._training_log_dir)
672	
673	        # Save manifest immediately so post-processing tools can find this run.
674	        run_dir = self._training_log_dir / run_id
675	        manifest = TrainingRunManifest.create(
676	            run_id=run_id,
677	            compressor_type=type(self._compressor).__name__,
678	            n_train_requests=len(self._user_requests),
679	            checkpoint_dir=self._checkpoint_dir,
680	            run_name=getattr(self._config, "run_name", "") or "",
681	            reward_weights=self._reward_config.weights.model_dump(),
682	            ppo_hyperparams=self._config.ppo.model_dump(),
683	            n_envs=self._config.n_envs,
684	            num_timesteps=n_steps,
685	            extra={"device": self._device},
686	        )
687	        save_manifest(manifest, run_dir)
688	        log.info("trainer.manifest.saved", run_id=run_id, path=str(run_dir / "manifest.json"))
689	
690	        # Build vectorised env (with WorldPool if configured)
691	        vec_env = self._make_vec_env()
692	
693	        # Build val env factory if a val split was provided.
694	        # Kept separate from the training WorldPool so val episodes always run on
695	        # a fresh, deterministic simulator rather than sharing pool state.
696	        val_env_factory = (
697	            self._make_val_env_factory(self._val_requests)
698	            if self._val_requests
699	            else None
700	        )
701	        if val_env_factory is None:
702	            log.info("val_eval.skipped", reason="no val requests provided")
703	
704	        # Build or restore PPO model and move to device
705	        if self._config.resume_from:
706	            self._ppo = self._load_ppo(self._config.resume_from, vec_env)
707	        else:
708	            self._ppo = self._build_ppo(vec_env)
709	
710	        # Explicitly move the compressor to the training device.
711	        # SB3 moves standard policy layers (token_embed, value_net) automatically,
712	        # but the compressor's HF model is a nested object that needs explicit placement.
713	        try:
714	            self._compressor.to(self._device)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
715	        except AttributeError:
716	            pass  # non-HF compressors (IdentityCompressor) may not expose .to()
717	
718	        # Build callbacks
719	        callbacks = self._build_callbacks(run_logger=run_logger, val_env_factory=val_env_factory)
720	
721	        # Run training
722	        try:
723	            self._ppo.learn(
724	                total_timesteps=n_steps,
725	                callback=callbacks,
726	                reset_num_timesteps=not bool(self._config.resume_from),
727	            )
728	        finally:
729	            run_logger.close()
730	
731	    def save_checkpoint(self, path: str | Path | None = None) -> None:
732	        """
733	        Save SB3 PPO model + compressor weights.
734	
735	        Parameters
736	        ----------
737	        path : Directory to save into. Defaults to ``checkpoint_dir/final``.
738	        """
739	        if self._ppo is None:
740	            raise RuntimeError("No trained model to save. Call train() first.")
741	
742	        save_dir = Path(path) if path else self._checkpoint_dir / "final"
743	        save_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
744	
745	        # SB3 saves policy + optimizer state into a single zip
746	        ppo_path = save_dir / "ppo_model"
747	        self._ppo.save(str(ppo_path))
748	
749	        # Compressor weights (HF format or custom)
750	        compressor_path = save_dir / "compressor"
751	        compressor_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
752	        self._compressor.save_checkpoint(str(compressor_path))
753	
754	    def load_checkpoint(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
755	        """
756	        Load compressor weights from a checkpoint directory.
757	
758	        Note: To resume SB3 PPO training state (optimizer, step count), call
759	        ``train()`` with ``config.resume_from`` set. This method only restores
760	        the compressor model weights.
761	
762	        Parameters
763	        ----------
764	        path : Directory containing the ``compressor/`` sub-directory.
765	        """

767	        if not compressor_path.exists():
768	            # Allow passing the compressor directory directly
769	            compressor_path = Path(path)
770	        self._compressor.load_checkpoint(str(compressor_path))
771	
772	    # ── Private helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
773	
774	    def _make_vec_env(self) -> VecEnv:
775	        """
776	        Create a vectorised ``CompressionEnv`` using SB3's ``make_vec_env``.
777	
778	        Uses WorldPool when ``simulator_config.unique_per_episode=False`` (default)
779	        to avoid regenerating a world on every reset.  Falls back to the raw
780	        simulator_factory when unique_per_episode=True.
781	
782	        Each parallel environment gets its own ReActAgent on every reset(),
783	        so there is no shared policy state across workers.
784	        """
785	        reward_fn = RewardFunction(config=self._reward_config)
786	        env_config = self._env_config
787	        tokenizer = self._tokenizer
788	        agent_factory = self._agent_factory
789	        user_requests = self._user_requests
790	
791	        # Choose simulator source: pool or fresh-per-episode
792	        if self._simulator_config.unique_per_episode:
793	            effective_factory = self._simulator_factory
794	        else:
795	            pool = WorldPool(
796	                simulator_factory=self._simulator_factory,
797	                pool_size=self._simulator_config.pool_size,
798	                seed_range=tuple(self._simulator_config.seed_range),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
799	                rng_seed=getattr(self._config, "seed", 42),
800	            )
801	            pool.build()
802	            log.info("world_pool.ready", pool_size=len(pool))
803	            effective_factory = pool.sample
804	
805	        def env_factory() -> CompressionEnv:
806	            return CompressionEnv(
807	                agent_factory=agent_factory,
808	                simulator_factory=effective_factory,
809	                reward_fn=reward_fn,
810	                user_requests=user_requests,
811	                config=env_config,
812	                tokenizer=tokenizer,
813	            )
814	
815	        # SubprocVecEnv runs each env in a separate process, overlapping LLM
816	        # API calls and cutting wall time roughly in half on Colab (Linux fork).
817	        #
818	        # Safety constraint: if the compressor has learnable weights, PPO updates
819	        # in the main process would NOT propagate to subprocess copies — those
820	        # agents would always use the initial weights, creating a train/inference
821	        # mismatch. For such compressors we fall back to DummyVecEnv (sequential
822	        # but weight-consistent).
823	        _has_learnable_weights = False
824	        try:
825	            _has_learnable_weights = any(
826	                p.requires_grad for p in self._compressor.parameters()  # type: ignore[union-attr]
827	            )
828	        except (AttributeError, StopIteration):
829	            pass  # non-PyTorch compressor (e.g. IdentityCompressor) → treat as stateless
830	
831	        if _has_learnable_weights:
832	            vec_env_cls: type[VecEnv] = DummyVecEnv
833	            log.info("vec_env.dummy", reason="compressor has learnable weights; SubprocVecEnv would break weight sync")
834	        else:
835	            vec_env_cls = SubprocVecEnv
836	            log.info("vec_env.subproc", n_envs=self._config.n_envs,
837	                     note="parallel LLM calls; ~2x wall-time speedup on Colab")
838	
839	        vec_env = make_vec_env(
840	            env_factory,
841	            n_envs=self._config.n_envs,
842	            seed=getattr(self._config, "seed", None),
